# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old as of the summer after Anne's first year of teaching.  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c33 P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is described as a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy is quiet, stolid, and suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts. He is extremely shy around others and harbors an intense, unspoken admiration for Anne Shirley, feeling puffed up with pride whenever he gets to drive her.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

## Traits

- Quiet and stolid  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Lacks conversational skills  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Easily intimidated or fearful of social situations  <sub>[v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a horse and buggy  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews is a young man from Avonlea who lives with his family. When his sister Jane was unable to dry her tears at school, she borrowed a handkerchief from him. He later drives his sister Jane, Anne Shirley, and Diana Barry to the White Sands Hotel in his family's double-seated buggy for a benefit concert. During the drive, he insists that Anne sit beside him on the front seat, though he grins and chuckles without being able to think of answers to her conversation in time. After the concert, he waits for the girls outside with the team, having fled the hotel in fear of being invited to the formal late-night supper.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_
